narrativeThesis.theme: Unity has meaning only when distinct peoples choose it freely.
narrativeThesis.dramaticQuestion: Can four rival realms protect their identities while trusting one another enough to deny a peace imposed by force?
narrativeThesis.playerPromise: Every main chapter advances the world-scale mystery, while optional side quests make its people, history, systems, and consequences understandable and emotionally worthwhile.
narrativeThesis.sideQuestRule: Side quests enrich comprehension, preparation, relationships, and epilogue presentation but never gate critical progression.

veilWatch.role: A cross-realm military and scholarly order that monitors breaches in the Veil.

wishDragon.role: Keeper of Unmade Wishes; grants no wish obtained through coercion or the erasure of a realm's will.

centerIsland.rule: The only neutral outer-warzone zone; PvP is disabled and cross-realm trade and conversation are possible.

sharedLanguage.rule: Vaeloryn's consideration translates willing speech only while participants remain on Accordant Isle; it never erases native languages.

antagonist.formerRole: First Commander of the Veil Watch
antagonist.motivation: After seeing the four realms betray a shared defense during the First War, Edras concluded that choice itself made peace impossible. He seeks all eight gems to force one realm, one voice, and one will under his regency.
antagonist.lie: He claims Vaeloryn demanded the realms be unified; in truth, the dragon refused his coerced wish and cast his Veil-bound remnant away.
antagonist.defeatCondition: Expose the lie, prevent a coerced wish, defeat the Hollow Regent at the final convergence, and speak a voluntary wish that preserves every realm's identity.

globalQuestRules.mainQuestAbandonment: A critical quest may be paused outside an active encounter or committed objective, but critical progress is preserved and the next safe step remains visible.
globalQuestRules.sideQuestAbandonment: Side quests may be abandoned and reaccepted without changing main-quest eligibility, required levels, gem custody, Warmaster eligibility, or the ending.
globalQuestRules.failureAndRetry: Ordinary failure is recoverable and nonterminal. Retry resumes at the latest safe objective; no required artifact, gem, realm choice, or one-time consequence duplicates.
globalQuestRules.resume: Reload restores the current chapter, quest, objective, unresolved choice, active encounter identity when authoritative, and all earned optional feedback flags.
